name: Producer Pal
description: AI music production assistant for Ableton Live. Generate and edit MIDI clips, control playback, manage tracks, scenes, and the arrangement.
long_description:
To use: Add the Producer Pal device (Producer_Pal.amxd) to an empty MIDI track in Ableton Live. Ask Claude Desktop (with this extension enabled): "connect to ableton".
Requires Ableton Live 12.3+ with Max for Live (e.g. Ableton Live Suite).

mcp_server_origin.title: Ableton device URL
mcp_server_origin.description: URL for connecting to the Producer Pal Max for Live device (protocol://host:port). Use http://localhost:[port] for local connections or http://[IP]:[port] for network connections. The port number must match the port in the Max for Live device's advanced settings (default port is 3350). Restart this extension after changing the URL. Default: http://localhost:3350

notation.title: MIDI notation
notation.description: Valid values are 'barbeat', 'stark', or 'midi-json'. Overrides the MIDI notation for reading and writing clips. 'barbeat' is recommended for Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable; use 'stark' with Small model mode, or 'midi-json' with JSON output. Leave blank, or enter anything else, to keep the device's current setting (barbeat by default). Global device setting: also affects the chat UI and other MCP clients. Restart this extension after changing.

small_model_mode.title: Small model mode
small_model_mode.description: Simplifies the tools and instructions for smaller models. May improve results with Claude Haiku; not recommended otherwise, since Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable handle the full toolset. Pairs well with MIDI notation set to 'stark'. Global device setting (also affects the chat UI and other MCP clients). Restart this extension after changing.

live_api.title: Direct Live API
live_api.description: Enables the advanced ppal-live-api tool for direct access to the Ableton Live Object Model. An escape hatch for custom control, integrations, and debugging when Producer Pal's standard tools aren't enough — not recommended as a default. Global device setting (also affects the chat UI and other MCP clients). Restart this extension after changing.

json_output.title: JSON output
json_output.description: Returns tool results as JSON instead of the compact default. Not recommended for normal use because it increases token usage, but useful when you want Claude to run code on the results. Pairs well with MIDI notation set to 'midi-json'. Restart this extension after changing.
